paragraphs: R' Yochanan, son of R' Simon.
Mentioned in the Yalkut on Song of Songs, remez 982. Hyman calls this a scribal error: it should read R' Yehudah, son of R' Simon, as the statement appears in Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:7.[^1][^2]

notes.text: בר״ס is contextually son of Simon from the heading, retaining its father-title component as R'; the heading does not license a full Rabbi expansion in either occurrence. All four title components remain R'.

תתקפ״ב totals 982; פ״א־ז is contextually 1:7 without verified modern correspondence. First ילקוט שהש״ר is rendered Yalkut on Song of Songs, with its final resh unexplained; second בשהש״ר is the conventional Midrash work title. The two works are distinct, with no added Shimoni or conflated Yalkut-Rabbah. Hyman’s scribal-error/should-read assertion keeps its strength and ownership, without adopting Yehudah into the heading.
